Subject: CarePlus trial: recommended hosting path + success gates

Hi Aisha / Tom — thanks again for the productive call today. This thread is a short recap and a recommended path forward so we can start the trial quickly and make sure the evaluation answers your top priorities. TL;DR: start with hosted API for integration speed + a short dedicated sandbox window for load/resilience tests, with a parallel security checklist review for the VPC option if you need strict network isolation.

High-level options (pros/cons):
- Hosted API (fastest): minimal ops, quick onboarding, good for functional validation and SSO integration; limited control over data plane but we offer strong data handling controls and per-customer retention policies.
- Dedicated sandbox (recommended for load testing): reserved GPU pool for predictable throughput and realistic performance numbers; short-term reservation (2–4 weeks) to run throughput and p95 latency tests.
- VPC/private deployment: full network isolation and customer-managed control plane; longer lead time (typically 4–8 weeks) for infra/network setup and compliance sign-off.

Proposed evaluation plan & success gates (suggested):
1) Functional integration (owner: CarePlus / Aisha): API calls implemented, auth via SAML or API key, and end-to-end flows working in staging. Goal: successful flows for 3 representative endpoints (summaries, Q&A, document ingestion) by week 1.
2) Latency & throughput (owner: Redwood / Marissa): dedicated sandbox for 72-hour soak test. Goal: p95 generation latency < 350ms at target concurrency; 99th percentile error rate < 1%.
3) Cost benchmarking (owner: Redwood / Karthik): token cost estimate and operational cost projection under the test workload. Goal: projected per-1M-token cost within agreed budget range.
4) Security/compliance (owner: CarePlus security + Redwood security): SOC2 artifact review, data retention config, and network requirements. Goal: checklist items resolved or flagged for VPC.

Tentative timeline (if we start next week):
- Day 0: kickoff + exchange of security checklist (I attached the checklist and a draft MA plan).
- Days 1–3: Hosted API onboarding + functional validation with Redwood sandbox keys.
- Days 4–10: Dedicated sandbox reserved for load testing (2–3 days active test + tuning).
- Day 11–14: Results review, cost estimate, and decision on VPC trial (if required).

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: confirm which datasets (PII/no-PII) you want in the trial and whether you need a VPC by Friday.
- Tom: share target concurrency and token volumes for typical peak windows.
- Marissa: reserve dedicated sandbox window and provide test harness.
- Karthik: produce cost projection and required config parameters.

Attachments: CarePlus_Security_Checklist.pdf (security questions), PoC_MAPlan.xlsx (mutual action plan draft). Links: HubSpot deal and DocuSign packet (we can sign MA plan when milestones are agreed).

Next step from our side: if you confirm data residency and peak volumes, we’ll provision hosted keys today and lock a 7-day window for dedicated sandbox starting next Tuesday.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — this is great, thanks for pulling together. A few quick clarifications from our side:
1) Data: initial trial will use de-identified clinical notes (no direct identifiers). We may test a small sample with tokenized PHI if needed, but that requires a signed DPA and KMS discussion.
2) Residency: Must be US-only processing for the trial data. Is the hosted API explicitly able to restrict processing regionally?
3) Volumes: peak concurrency is ~120 concurrent sessions, typical daily tokens ~8M.

We are comfortable starting with hosted + dedicated sandbox as you suggested. Please send the hosted keys and proposed dedicated window options. I’ll route the security checklist to our InfoSec folks — they’ll follow up on SOC2 artifacts (expect questions around logging and key rotation).

Appreciate the clear gates. Aisha
